title: Improve cold-flow accuracy, curved stress balance and full-update robustness
description: The bounded conservative MHD reference is verified, but the independent double rarefaction has 114 percent central pressure error at nz640 despite converging bulk L1 errors and inactive positivity limiting. Curved-equilibrium force RMS converges at about order 1.5. Improve and quantify these errors and test stronger multidimensional low-pressure updates without cell floors or energy repairs. Preserve independent analytic references, conservation, divergence, limiter activity, and mesh/time studies. See docs/POSITIVITY_VERIFICATION.md and docs/EQUILIBRIUM_VERIFICATION.md. Resolve accuracy for the eventual formation regime before physical claims.

title: Demonstrate converged FRC formation experiments and honest diagnostics
description: Compare prescribed waveform families using the coupled dynamic model. Establish mesh, time, boundary and transport robustness. Separate reversal, closed flux, force balance, lifetime, model applicability and stability; retain reproducible outputs and interactive experiment controls.

title: Numerically verified and physically credible FRC experiment simulator
description:
# Active objective: a credible experimental FRC simulation

The goal is a numerically verified and physically justified simulation in which
we can vary geometry, plasma and prescribed coil waveforms to investigate FRC
formation. Passing the existing stationary-conductor tests is not completion.

## Completion evidence still required

1. Conservative axisymmetric compressible dynamics: mass, momentum, pressure/
   total energy, magnetic advection and resistivity, with compatible div B.
2. Verified plasma–vacuum coupling and suitable chamber/end/outer boundaries;
   no undisclosed conducting or massive numerical atmosphere.
3. A defensible transport/ionization model for the selected regime, with local
   scale/collisionality checks; Hall/two-fluid or kinetic treatment if required.
4. Independent tests of waves, shocks, magnetic forces, diffusion/heating and
   equilibrium preservation, including convergence and energy budgets.
5. Converged formation experiments with separate reversal, topology, force
   balance, lifetime and model-validity criteria. Robustness to time step, mesh,
   boundary and transport choices; no claim of stability from axisymmetry alone.
6. Scriptable and interactive experiments with complete reproducibility records
   and diagnostics that do not overstate the supported conclusions.

## Current evidence

The previous turn was progress: Stage 0/1 are implemented, 33 tests pass, and
three waveforms plus a 27-case sweep have measured sensitivity studies. Their
topology durations are not converged and their illustrative argon parameters
raise serious missing-physics warnings. No dynamic MHD experiment exists yet.

## Current development step

Develop a conservative r-z MHD kernel with a staggered flux representation and
explicit numerical dissipation. Use a gas-filled verification cylinder with
periodic axial and fixed conducting radial boundaries first, clearly separated
from the quartz-tube formation experiment. Verify it before coupling to the
external coil/vacuum problem. These verification boundaries do not fulfill the
physical experimental boundary requirement above.

The full objective remains active until all completion evidence is present.
notes: This continuation made concrete progress in dynamic physics. The full FRC objective is not achieved: experimental coupling, transport/Hall validation and converged formation remain open. Requirements audit and next implementation candidates are persisted in docs/GOAL_STATUS.md.

title: Conservative axisymmetric resistive MHD core and independent verification
description: Implement the conservative poloidal axisymmetric resistive-MHD reference in its declared gas-filled conducting-wall, periodic domain. Verify mass, momentum, total energy, constrained induction, waves, shocks, advection, resistive heating, force balance and equilibrium refinement against independent references. The coupled moving plasma-vacuum/source problem belongs to frc-vacuum; physical transport to frc-transport. The bounded milestone is implemented with first-order and second-order methods, local admissible reconstruction, 62 passing tests and reproducible reports. Further cold-flow accuracy and full-update robustness are tracked in frc-accuracy.
notes: Final bounded-core checkpoint: 62 tests pass. Previously rejected p0=.1 Pa equilibria now complete on nr12/24 without modifying cell mass/energy; pressure blending activates in 12.10/2.19 percent of accepted cell-stages and vanishes at nr48/96. Independent source quadrature, relative-unit scaling and bitwise unchanged smooth evolution are verified. Stress cases p0=.001 and 1e-5 finish but remain intentionally underresolved. The new exact double rarefaction has converging bulk L1 errors yet 114 percent central-pressure error at nz640, with limiter inactive; frc-accuracy preserves this limitation. All reported cases conserve mass/energy and face divergence. Physical FRC goal remains active; next integration is genuine vacuum and coil source-work coupling.
close_reason: Bounded conservative reference and independent verification implemented. Remaining numerical accuracy is tracked in frc-accuracy; dynamic vacuum/coils and physical closure remain open. This does not close the full FRC goal.

title: Establish transport, ionization, and Hall/two-fluid validity for target regime
description: Determine target physical regime from user parameters where available. Add defensible collision and conductivity closures, local scale checks and Hall/two-fluid extensions when required. Original argon fixture has ion skin depth exceeding chamber plasma radius; scalar-conductivity MHD is not validated for it.

title: Couple moving plasma, external coils, and genuine vacuum with verified boundaries
description: Implement a verified evolving plasma-vacuum interface and external source coupling. Preserve exact nonconducting exterior without a hidden fluid atmosphere. Quantify source work, free/open boundary error, pressure balance and end effects.
